Interface TextBox<S extends Shape<S,P>,P extends TextParagraph<S,P,? extends TextRun>>

All Superinterfaces:
AutoShape<S,P>, IAdjustableShape, Iterable<P>, PlaceableShape<S,P>, Shape<S,P>, SimpleShape<S,P>, TextShape<S,P>
All Known Implementing Classes:

public interface TextBox<S extends Shape<S,P>,P extends TextParagraph<S,P,? extends TextRun>> extends AutoShape<S,P>
Represents a TextFrame shape in PowerPoint.

Contains the text in a text frame as well as the properties and methods that control alignment and anchoring of the text.
